snippet.title: Worldwide Release on January 22nd | Arknights: Endfield Official Release PV
snippet.description:
From these lands beneath to the planets above, the path we tread together remains unbroken. Once more, we venture forth as one—to chart the unknown and forge the future

Arknights: Endfield is officially set for its worldwide release on January 22nd, 2026

Special guest @OneRepublic  presents the brand-new theme track for Arknights: Endfield "Give Me Something"

New Sound Track: https://onerepublic.lnk.to/GMSLF

Pre-registration is now open on all available platforms: https://endfield.gryphline.com
